verdict.rationale: Nix keeps a user's setup in plain-text declarative files such as /etc/nixos/configuration.nix (nix-docs-15, nix-docs-46). It also advertises easy transfer of software environments between computers (nix-docs-53), so the user's configuration is portable and readable rather than locked in a proprietary store. That format is still Nix's own functional language, and nothing documents exporting to neutral formats or migrating off Nix. missing for 10: an explicit data-export or migration path, conversion of configs into tool-neutral formats, any evidence about leaving Nix, independent corroboration.
